name: Margarine
siboNotes: Pure margarine is FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. Check labels for added inulin, chicory root, or other FODMAP ingredients in specialty varieties.
preparationTips: Choose margarine without added fiber ingredients like inulin
Read labels carefully on flavored varieties which may contain garlic or onion
Store at room temperature for easy spreading
Use in baking as a butter substitute in FODMAP recipes
nutritionalHighlights: Lower in saturated fat than butter
